    // CUDA / HIP graph and replayed - the same kernels with the same arguments, so the same bits, without a launch a
    // kernel from the host (Windows + AMD: ~2000 launches a token, each a host-side cost that left the GPU waiting).
    // Only where nothing in the forward needs the host: one GPU, every MoE layer host-free, the token kernels.  A
    // graph is keyed by its tokens, its head rows, the indexer's block count (the one argument that moves with the
    // position: every 128 tokens - a new capture then) and the residual stream's buffer (a prompt's MoE layers swap h
    // and out: a graph captured before a prompt would read the other one after it).  MAYA_MM3_GRAPH=0: no graphs
    // (--parallel: the key also holds the bound sequence - its caches are the graph's - and a forward_rows step's
    //  rows' sequences and block counts; graphs are dropped least recently used first, kGraphKeep kept)
    struct GraphEntry {
        cudaGraphExec_t exec = nullptr;
        long profiled = 0;   // (st.profiled's count of one replay: the capture's)
        long long used = 0;
    };
    std::map, GraphEntry> graphs;
    long long graph_clock = 0;
    static constexpr size_t kGraphKeep = 12;
    bool graph_on = false;   // (load: the conditions above, and the setting)
    bool graph_ready(int T, int want) const {
        return graph_on && T <= kWin && o.fast_decode && (want == 0 || want <= kWin) && !pf.on;
    }
    void graphs_clear() {
        for (auto& kv : graphs)
            if (kv.second.exec) cudaGraphExecDestroy(kv.second.exec);
        graphs.clear();
    }
    template 
    bool run_graph(int T, int want, F& body, std::string& err) {
        Dev& d = D[(size_t) 0];
        const bool rows = !rseq.empty();
        const int nblk = rows ? -1 : cur_pos / g.blk + 1;
        std::vector key{T, want, nblk, (long long) (uintptr_t) d.h, rows ? -1 : bound};
        for (size_t r = 0; r < rseq.size(); ++r) {
            key.push_back(rseq[r]);
            key.push_back(rpos[r] / g.blk + 1);
        }
        auto it = graphs.find(key);
        if (it == graphs.end()) {
            if (o.seqs <= 1) {   // (the graphs of other block counts are behind the position now: dropped)
                for (auto g2 = graphs.begin(); g2 != graphs.end();) {
                    if (g2->first[2] != nblk) {
                        cudaGraphExecDestroy(g2->second.exec);
                        g2 = graphs.erase(g2);
                    } else {
                        ++g2;
                    }
                }
            } else {   // (several conversations' positions: the least recently used beyond kGraphKeep)
                while (graphs.size() >= kGraphKeep) {
                    auto lru = graphs.begin();
                    for (auto g2 = graphs.begin(); g2 != graphs.end(); ++g2)
                        if (g2->second.used < lru->second.used) lru = g2;
                    cudaGraphExecDestroy(lru->second.exec);
                    graphs.erase(lru);
                }
            }
            const long p0 = st.profiled;
            cudaGraph_t gr = nullptr;
            cudaGraphExec_t ex = nullptr;
            bool ok = cudaStreamBeginCapture(d.s, cudaStreamCaptureModeThreadLocal) == cudaSuccess;
            const bool ran = ok && body(true);
            const cudaError_t ee = cudaStreamEndCapture(d.s, &gr);   // (always: the stream leaves capture)
            ok = ok && ran && ee == cudaSuccess && gr != nullptr && cudaGraphInstantiate(&ex, gr, 0) == cudaSuccess;
            if (gr) cudaGraphDestroy(gr);
            const long added = st.profiled - p0;
            st.profiled = p0;
            if (!ok) {   // (nothing of the capture ran: the forward the usual way, and no graphs from now on)
                if (ex) cudaGraphExecDestroy(ex);
                cudaGetLastError();
                graph_on = false;
                info.push_back("NOTE: graphs off: a forward did not capture (" + (err.empty() ? std::string("CUDA") : err) +
                               ") - the kernels launched one by one");
                std::fprintf(stderr, "maya-mm3: %s\n", info.back().c_str());
                err.clear();
                return body(false);
            }
            it = graphs.emplace(key, GraphEntry{ex, added}).first;
        }
        it->second.used = ++graph_clock;
        CK(cudaGraphLaunch(it->second.exec, d.s));
        st.profiled += it->second.profiled;
        return true;
    }

    // a forward's residual rows from GPU a's stream to b's (dst on b): b's stream waits on a's work there through an
    // event, the host goes on enqueueing (CUDA; HIP - whose queued work Windows submits only at a host wait - and
    // MAYA_MM3_HOP_EVENTS=0: the host waits for a's stream first, as before)
    bool hop_events = [] {
#if defined(STRATA_USE_HIP)
        return false;
#else
        const char* v = ::mm3::env("MM3_HOP_EVENTS");
        return v == nullptr || std::atoi(v) != 0;
#endif
    }();
    bool hop(Dev& a, Dev& b, size_t bytes, float* dst, std::string& err) {
        CK(cudaSetDevice(a.id));
        if (hop_events) {
            CK(cudaEventRecord(a.hop, a.s));
            CK(cudaSetDevice(b.id));
            CK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(b.s, a.hop, 0));
        } else {
            CK(cudaStreamSynchronize(a.s));
            CK(cudaSetDevice(b.id));
        }
        return copy_peer(dst, b, a.h, a, bytes, b.s, err);
    }
    // peer access between every two of the GPUs where they have it (load): the forward's copies across then a plain
    // device copy - one a graph can hold - else the runtime's peer copy (through the host where the GPUs cannot)
    bool p2p_all = false;
    bool copy_peer(void* dst, const Dev& db, const void* src, const Dev& sb, size_t bytes, cudaStream_t s,
                   std::string& err) {
        if (p2p_all) CK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dst, src, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, s));
        else CK(cudaMemcpyPeerAsync(dst, db.id, src, sb.id, bytes, s));
        return true;
    }

    bool chunk(const int* ids, int T, int pos0, int want, float* logits, std::string& err) {
        const double tc = now();
        const bool ok = chunk_(ids, T, pos0, want, logits, err);
        if (T == 1) st.t_token += now() - tc;
        if (pf.on) {
            if (ok) pcollect(T == 1 ? 0 : T <= kWin && o.fast_decode ? 1 : 2, T, now() - tc);
            pf.used = 0;
        }
        return ok;
    }

    // the embeddings of T tokens (rows from the file: BF16, or a GGUF's block type dequantized as ggml does) -> F32 h
    bool embed(const int* ids, int T, float* h, std::string& err) const {
        const Tensor* emb = pk.get(P + "embed_tokens.weight");
        const uint16_t* e16 = (const uint16_t*) pk.data(*emb);
        for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {
            if (ids[t] < 0 || ids[t] >= g.vocab) {
                err = "token id " + std::to_string(ids[t]) + " outside the vocabulary";
                return false;
            }
            if (emb->dtype != "BF16") {
                if (!gg::host_row(emb->dtype, pk.data(*emb), g.dim, ids[t], &h[(size_t) t * g.dim])) {
                    err = "the token embedding's type " + emb->dtype + " is not read here";
                    return false;
                }
                continue;
            }
            const uint16_t* r = e16 + (size_t) ids[t] * g.dim;
            for (int i = 0; i < g.dim; ++i) {
                const uint32_t u = (uint32_t) r[i] << 16;
                std::memcpy(&h[(size_t) t * g.dim + i], &u, 4);
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    // ---- --parallel on a layer split: the GPUs as a pipeline (Model::pipe_tick).  A group - one token of each of its
    // conversations, as forward_rows' rows - enters the first GPU's layers while the groups before it run the later
    // GPUs'.  A tick runs each GPU's group through that GPU's layers, one layer of each GPU in turn (the oldest group
    // first): a GPU's wait for its routing on the host leaves the others running what is queued; then the last GPU's
    // group's logits are read and every other group moves one GPU on.  Each row the same bits as forward_rows' (the
    // window kernels, its attention on the token path's calls over its own cache).
    struct PGroup {
        int tag = -1;   // (-1: no group)
        std::vector ids, seq, pos;
    };
    std::vector stage_dev;          // the GPUs holding layers, in layer order
    std::vector pst;             // the group at each stage
    std::deque>> pout;   // finished groups: tag, logits [rows][vocab]
    int pipe_busy() const {
        int n = 0;
        for (const PGroup& q : pst) n += q.tag >= 0;
        return n;
    }
    void pipe_drop() {
        for (PGroup& q : pst) q.tag = -1;
        pout.clear();
        for (Dev& d : D) {
            cudaSetDevice(d.id);
            cudaStreamSynchronize(d.s);
        }
        cudaGetLastError();
    }
    bool pipe_tick(const int* ids, const int* sq, const int* ps, int R, int tag, std::string& err) {
        const int S = (int) stage_dev.size();
        if (pst.size() != (size_t) S) pst.assign((size_t) S, PGroup{});
        if (R > 0) {
            if (pst[0].tag >= 0 || R > kWin || tag < 0) {
                err = "pipe_tick: the first GPU is not free, or a group of " + std::to_string(R) + " rows";
                return false;
            }
            for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {   // (a sequence in one row of one group at most)
                bool clash = sq[r] < 0 || sq[r] >= (int) L[0].sk.size() || std::find(sq, sq + r, sq[r]) != sq + r ||
                             ps[r] + 1 > o.max_ctx;
                for (const PGroup& q : pst)
                    if (q.tag >= 0 && std::find(q.seq.begin(), q.seq.end(), sq[r]) != q.seq.end()) clash = true;
                if (clash) {
                    err = "pipe_tick: sequence " + std::to_string(sq[r]) + " at " + std::to_string(ps[r]) +
                          ": busy, out of range or past the context";
                    return false;
                }
            }
            PGroup& q = pst[0];
            q.tag = tag;
            q.ids.assign(ids, ids + R);
            q.seq.assign(sq, sq + R);
            q.pos.assign(ps, ps + R);
            Dev& d0 = D[(size_t) stage_dev[0]];
            if (!embed(ids, R, d0.emb_h, err)) {
                q.tag = -1;
                return false;
            }
            CK(cudaSetDevice(d0.id));
            CK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d0.h, d0.emb_h, (size_t) R * g.dim * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, d0.s));
        }
        ++fwd;
        for (Dev& d : D) {
            CK(cudaSetDevice(d.id));
            refresh_slots(d);
        }
        for (int s = 0; s < S; ++s) {   // (each GPU's positions: its group's)
            const PGroup& q = pst[(size_t) s];
            if (q.tag < 0) continue;
            Dev& d = D[(size_t) stage_dev[(size_t) s]];
            for (size_t r = 0; r < q.pos.size(); ++r) d.pos_h[r] = q.pos[r];
            CK(cudaSetDevice(d.id));
            CK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d.pos, d.pos_h, q.pos.size() * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, d.s));
        }
        // (each GPU's turn: the second half of its last layer - the wait for its routing, its experts - then the first
        //  half of its next one, so the GPU has that queued while the host turns to the others)
        std::vector at((size_t) S, 0);
        std::vector pend((size_t) S, -1);
        bool ok = true;
        for (bool more = true; more && ok;) {
            more = false;
            for (int s = S - 1; s >= 0 && ok; --s) {
                const PGroup& q = pst[(size_t) s];
                Dev& d = D[(size_t) stage_dev[(size_t) s]];
                if (q.tag < 0) continue;
                rseq = q.seq;
                rpos = q.pos;
                cur_pos = *std::max_element(rpos.begin(), rpos.end());
                const int R = (int) q.seq.size();
                ok = cudaSetDevice(d.id) == cudaSuccess;
                if (ok && pend[(size_t) s] >= 0) {
                    ok = window_post(L[(size_t) pend[(size_t) s]], d, R, err);
                    pend[(size_t) s] = -1;
                    more = true;
                }
                if (ok && at[(size_t) s] < d.layers.size()) {
                    Layer& l = L[(size_t) d.layers[at[(size_t) s]++]];
                    ok = window_pre(l, d, l.dev, R, err);
                    if (l.moe) pend[(size_t) s] = (int) (&l - L.data());
                    more = true;
                }
                k::submit(d.s);
            }
        }
        rseq.clear();
        rpos.clear();
        if (!ok) {
            if (err.empty()) err = "pipe_tick: a layer failed";
            return false;
        }
        const PGroup& last = pst[(size_t) S - 1];
        const int RL = last.tag >= 0 ? (int) last.seq.size() : 0;
        Dev& hd = D[(size_t) head_dev];
        if (RL > 0) {   // (the last GPU's group: the head's GEMV, as a token's)
            CK(cudaSetDevice(hd.id));
            k::rms(hd.h, norm1, RL, g.dim, g.eps, hd.xn, hd.xn16, hd.s);
            const int cols = std::max(1, x3::mv_cols(head));
            for (int c0 = 0; c0 < RL; c0 += cols) {
                x3::MvJob j;
                j.m = &head;
                j.xf = hd.xn + (size_t) c0 * g.dim;
                j.y = hd.lg + (size_t) c0 * g.vocab;
                j.ncol = std::min(cols, RL - c0);
                j.xf_cs = (size_t) g.dim;
                j.y_cs = (size_t) g.vocab;
                if (!x3::mv(&j, 1, hd.s)) {
                    err = "mv head";
                    return false;
                }
            }
            CK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hd.lg_h, hd.lg, (size_t) RL * g.vocab * 4, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, hd.s));
        }
        for (Dev& d : D) {
            CK(cudaSetDevice(d.id));
            CK(cudaStreamSynchronize(d.s));
        }
        if (const int e = x3::launch_errors()) {
            err = "EXL3 launch errors: " + std::to_string(e);
            return false;
        }
        for (Dev& d : D)
            if (!d.promo_q.empty()) {
                CK(cudaSetDevice(d.id));
                issue_promotions(d);
            }
        if (RL > 0) {
            pout.emplace_back(last.tag, std::vector(hd.lg_h, hd.lg_h + (size_t) RL * g.vocab));
            pst[(size_t) S - 1].tag = -1;
        }
        for (int s = S - 2; s >= 0; --s) {   // (the others one GPU on, the later ones first: each one's room is free)
            PGroup& q = pst[(size_t) s];
            if (q.tag < 0) continue;
            Dev& a = D[(size_t) stage_dev[(size_t) s]];
            Dev& b = D[(size_t) stage_dev[(size_t) s + 1]];
            CK(cudaSetDevice(b.id));
            if (!copy_peer(b.h, b, a.h, a, q.seq.size() * (size_t) g.dim * 4, b.s, err)) return false;
            CK(cudaStreamSynchronize(b.s));
            std::swap(pst[(size_t) s + 1], q);
            q.tag = -1;
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool chunk_(const int* ids, int T, int pos0, int want, float* logits, std::string& err) {
        ++fwd;
        for (Dev& d : D) {
            CK(cudaSetDevice(d.id));
            refresh_slots(d);
        }
        const bool rows = !rseq.empty();   // (forward_rows: row t is sequence rseq[t]'s token at rpos[t])
        cur_pos = rows ? *std::max_element(rpos.begin(), rpos.end()) : pos0 + T - 1;
        if ((rows ? cur_pos + 1 : pos0 + T) > o.max_ctx) {
            err = "the context is full (" + std::to_string(o.max_ctx) + ")";
            return false;
        }
        float* h = D[(size_t) L[0].dev].emb_h;   // (pinned: the previous forward's copy of it is done - it waited)
        if (!embed(ids, T, h, err)) return false;
        for (const Model::Image& im : imgs) {   // (a picture's image tokens: its rows)
            if (rows) break;   // (the pictures are the bound sequence's prompt's)
            const int n = (int) (im.rows.size() / (size_t) g.dim);
            for (int q = std::max(im.start, pos0); q < std::min(im.start + n, pos0 + T); ++q)
                std::memcpy(&h[(size_t) (q - pos0) * g.dim], im.rows.data() + (size_t) (q - im.start) * g.dim,
                            (size_t) g.dim * 4);
        }
        for (Dev& d : D) {
            for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) d.pos_h[t] = rows ? rpos[(size_t) t] : pos0 + t;
            CK(cudaSetDevice(d.id));
            CK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d.pos, d.pos_h, (size_t) T * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, d.s));
        }
        int cur = L[0].dev;
        CK(cudaSetDevice(D[(size_t) cur].id));
        CK(cudaMemcpyAsync(D[(size_t) cur].h, h, (size_t) T * g.dim * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, D[(size_t) cur].s));
        pmark(D[(size_t) cur], kPAttnIn);   // (MAYA_MM3_PROF: the forward's start)
        // a token's or a verify window's rows through the head's GEMV (the same bits for each row), else the prompt's
        // head below
        const bool fast_head = want > 0 && want <= kWin && o.fast_decode;
        // the layers (and a fast head's GEMV): enqueued as they come, or (cap) captured into a graph
        auto body = [&](bool cap) -> bool {
            for (int li = 0; li < g.n_layers; ++li) {
                const int dv = L[(size_t) li].dev;
                if (dv != cur) {
                    if (!hop(D[(size_t) cur], D[(size_t) dv], (size_t) T * g.dim * 4, D[(size_t) dv].h, err)) return false;
                    cur = dv;
                }
                CK(cudaSetDevice(D[(size_t) dv].id));
                if (!layer(li, T, pos0 + T - 1, err)) return false;
                // (a token's or a window's layer: Windows + AMD start its queued work now - a host-free layer has no
                //  wait of its own that would, so the GPU runs this layer while the host enqueues the next)
                if (!cap && T <= kWin && o.fast_decode) k::submit(D[(size_t) dv].s);
                if (draftm && tap_of[(size_t) li] >= 0) {   // (the draft's context: this layer's output rows)
                    Dev& a = D[(size_t) dv];
                    Dev& hd = D[(size_t) head_dev];
                    float* dst = taps + (size_t) tap_of[(size_t) li] * T * g.dim;
                    if (dv == head_dev)
                        CK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dst, a.h, (size_t) T * g.dim * 4, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, a.s));
                    else if (!copy_peer(dst, hd, a.h, a, (size_t) T * g.dim * 4, a.s, err))
                        return false;
                }
                if (const char* dp = ::mm3::env("MM3_DUMP_HS")) {   // (debugging: every layer's residual stream, F32 rows)
                    std::vector hh((size_t) T * g.dim);
                    CK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hh.data(), D[(size_t) dv].h, hh.size() * 4, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
                                       D[(size_t) dv].s));
                    CK(cudaStreamSynchronize(D[(size_t) dv].s));
                    if (std::FILE* f = std::fopen(dp, li == 0 && pos0 == 0 ? "wb" : "ab")) {
                        std::fwrite(hh.data(), 4, hh.size(), f);
                        std::fclose(f);
                    }
                }
                if (o.verbose) {
                    CK(cudaStreamSynchronize(D[(size_t) dv].s));
                    const int e = x3::launch_errors();
                    if (e) {
                        err = "EXL3 launch errors: " + std::to_string(e);
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (want <= 0) return true;
            Dev& a = D[(size_t) cur];
            Dev& hd = D[(size_t) head_dev];
            if (cur != head_dev &&   // (the last layer on another GPU: its rows across; on the head's GPU stream order holds)
                !hop(a, hd, (size_t) T * g.dim * 4, hd.h, err))
                return false;
            CK(cudaSetDevice(hd.id));
            const float* last = hd.h + (size_t) (T - want) * g.dim;
            k::rms(last, norm1, want, g.dim, g.eps, hd.xn, hd.xn16, hd.s);
            if (fast_head) {
                const int cols = std::max(1, x3::mv_cols(head));   // (the split partials' scratch: ~5 rows a pass)
                for (int c0 = 0; c0 < want; c0 += cols) {
                    x3::MvJob j;
                    j.m = &head;
                    j.xf = hd.xn + (size_t) c0 * g.dim;
                    j.y = hd.lg + (size_t) c0 * g.vocab;
                    j.ncol = std::min(cols, want - c0);
                    j.xf_cs = (size_t) g.dim;
                    j.y_cs = (size_t) g.vocab;
                    if (!x3::mv(&j, 1, hd.s)) {
                        err = "mv head";
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
            return true;
        };
        if (!(graph_ready(T, want) ? run_graph(T, want, body, err) : body(false))) return false;
        if (want > 0) {
            Dev& hd = D[(size_t) head_dev];
            CK(cudaSetDevice(hd.id));
            if (fast_head) {
                pmark(hd, kPHead);
                CK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hd.lg_h, hd.lg, (size_t) want * g.vocab * 4, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, hd.s));
                CK(cudaStreamSynchronize(hd.s));
                std::memcpy(logits, hd.lg_h, (size_t) want * g.vocab * 4);
                want = 0;
            }
            // the head's output kHeadRows rows at a time
            for (int r0 = 0; r0 < want; r0 += kHeadRows) {
                const int nr = std::min(kHeadRows, want - r0);
                x3::gemm_rows(head, hd.xn16 + (size_t) r0 * g.dim, g.dim, nr, hd.lg, g.vocab, 0.0f, hd.s);
                CK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hd.lg_h, hd.lg, (size_t) nr * g.vocab * 4, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, hd.s));
                CK(cudaStreamSynchronize(hd.s));
                std::memcpy(logits + (size_t) r0 * g.vocab, hd.lg_h, (size_t) nr * g.vocab * 4);
            }
            if (want > 0) pmark(hd, kPHead);
        }
        for (Dev& d : D) {
            CK(cudaSetDevice(d.id));
            CK(cudaStreamSynchronize(d.s));
        }
        const int e = x3::launch_errors();
        if (e) {
            err = "EXL3 launch errors: " + std::to_string(e);
            return false;
        }
        for (Dev& d : D)
            if (!d.promo_q.empty()) {
                CK(cudaSetDevice(d.id));
                issue_promotions(d);
            }
        if (draftm && !rows) {
            CK(cudaSetDevice(D[(size_t) head_dev].id));
            if (!draftm->context(taps, T, pos0, err)) return false;
            pmark(D[(size_t) head_dev], kPDraft);
        }
        return true;
    }
};

Model::Model() : p(new Impl) {}
Model::~Model() {
    delete tpe;
    delete p;
}
bool Model::load(const Options& o_in, std::string& err) {
    Options o = o_in;
    if (o.gpus.empty()) {   // (no --gpus: the GPUs this engine runs on - compute capability 7.0 or newer; a display card
                            //  beside them, e.g. a Quadro P400, is left out with a NOTE)
        int n = 0;
        if (cudaGetDeviceCount(&n) != cudaSuccess || n == 0) {
            err = "no CUDA device";
            return false;
        }
        std::vector skipped;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            cudaDeviceProp pr{};
            if (cudaGetDeviceProperties(&pr, i) != cudaSuccess) continue;
            if (pr.major * 10 + pr.minor >= 70) o.gpus.push_back(i);
            else skipped.push_back("CUDA" + std::to_string(i) + " (" + pr.name + ", sm_" + std::to_string(pr.major) +
                                   std::to_string(pr.minor) + ")");
        }
        if (o.gpus.empty()) {
            err = "no GPU of compute capability 7.0 or newer (MiniMax-M3.1's engine needs a V100 or newer)";
            return false;
        }
        for (const auto& s : skipped)
            std::fprintf(stderr, "maya-mm3: NOTE: %s left out - compute capability below 7.0 (--gpus to choose)\n",
                         s.c_str());
    }
    // the prefill calibration of this PC (maya-mm3 --calibrate-prefill, the setup's calibration step): its chunk and
    // GEMM backend, where --chunk / --prefill-gemm do not choose; none: the engine's defaults, with a NOTE
    p->tkey = tune_key_of(o.gpus);
    p->tfile = o.prefill_tune.empty() ? o.pack + "/prefill-tune.txt" : o.prefill_tune;
    std::string tuned;
    if (o.tune && o.tp <= 0) {
        std::ifstream f(p->tfile);
        for (std::string line; std::getline(f, line);) {
            if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
            const size_t tab = line.find('\t');
            if (tab == std::string::npos || line.compare(0, tab, p->tkey) != 0) continue;
            std::istringstream is(line.substr(tab + 1));
            for (std::string kv; is >> kv;) {
                const size_t eq = kv.find('=');
                if (eq == std::string::npos) continue;
                const std::string k = kv.substr(0, eq);
                const int v = std::atoi(kv.c_str() + eq + 1);
                if (k == "chunk" && !o.chunk_given && v >= 64 && v <= 16384) o.chunk = v;
                else if (k == "gemm" && o.prefill_gemm < 0) o.prefill_gemm = v;
            }
            tuned = line.substr(tab + 1);
        }
    }
    if (o.tp > 0 && o.seqs > 1) {   // (--parallel: the layer split's batched steps - the tensor-parallel path runs one)
        Options o2 = o;
        o2.tp = 0;
        const bool ok = load(o2, err);
        p->info.insert(p->info.begin(), "NOTE: --tp " + std::to_string(o.tp) + " with --parallel " +
                                            std::to_string(o.seqs) + ": the layer split instead (the tensor-parallel "
                                            "path runs one conversation at a time)");
        return ok;
    }
    if (o.tp > 0) {   // (a GGUF pack: the layer split - the tensor-parallel path splits EXL3 matrices only)
        bool gg_pack = false;
        std::ifstream f(o.pack + "/mm3.txt");
        for (std::string line; std::getline(f, line);) {
            if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
            gg_pack = gg_pack || line == "format gguf";
        }
        if (gg_pack) {
            Options o2 = o;
            o2.tp = 0;
            const bool ok = p->load(o2, err);
            p->info.insert(p->info.begin(), "NOTE: --tp " + std::to_string(o.tp) + ": not with a GGUF pack - the layer "
                                            "split instead");
            return ok;
        }
    }
#if defined(_WIN32)
    // Windows: the tensor-parallel path's host waits on the GPUs' counters depend on its launches being submitted as
    // they are enqueued, which the WDDM driver batches - the layer split there (MAYA_MM3_TP_WINDOWS=1: try it anyway)
    if (o.tp > 0 && !(std::getenv("MAYA_MM3_TP_WINDOWS") && std::atoi(std::getenv("MAYA_MM3_TP_WINDOWS")) != 0)) {
        Options o2 = o;
        o2.tp = 0;
        const bool ok = p->load(o2, err);
        p->info.insert(p->info.begin(), "--tp " + std::to_string(o.tp) + ": not on Windows - the layer split instead");
        return ok;
    }
#endif
    if (o.tp > 0) {
        tpe = new TpEngine;
        if (tpe->load(o, err)) return true;
        // (the tensor-parallel path does not fit this PC - its memory, its GPUs: the layer split instead, which sizes
        //  itself to the memory, with a NOTE; its own error when that does not load either)
        const std::string why = err;
        delete tpe;   // (frees its GPU memory and pinned pool first)
        tpe = nullptr;
        Options o2 = o;
        o2.tp = 0;
        err.clear();
        std::fprintf(stderr, "maya-mm3: --tp %d did not load (%s): the layer split instead\n", o.tp, why.c_str());
        if (!p->load(o2, err)) {
            err = "--tp " + std::to_string(o.tp) + ": " + why + "; the layer split: " + err;
            return false;
        }
        p->info.insert(p->info.begin(), "NOTE: --tp " + std::to_string(o.tp) + " did not fit (" + why +
                                            "): the layer split instead");
        return true;
    }
    if (!p->load(o, err)) return false;
    if (!tuned.empty())
        p->info.push_back("prefill: this PC's calibration (" + p->tfile + "): chunk " + std::to_string(p->o.chunk) +
                          (p->gguf ? std::string(", ") + (gg::gemm_backend() == 1 ? "hipBLASLt" : "BLAS") + " GEMMs" : ""));
    else if (o.tune && o.tp <= 0)
        p->info.push_back("NOTE: prefill not calibrated on this PC (./maya.sh --calibrate measures it): chunk " +
                          std::to_string(p->o.chunk));
    return true;
}
int Model::chunk() const { return tpe ? 0 : p->run_chunk(); }
int Model::chunk_max() const { return tpe ? 0 : p->o.chunk; }
void Model::set_chunk(int c) { p->chunk_run = c; }
void Model::set_prefill_staging(int mode) { p->prefill_stage_mode = mode >= 0 && mode <= 2 ? mode : -1; }
void Model::set_prefill_gemm(int b) { gg::set_gemm(b); }
int Model::prefill_gemm() const { return gg::gemm_backend(); }
bool Model::lt_available() const { return !tpe && p->gguf && gg::gemm_lt_available(); }
std::string Model::tune_key() const { return p->tkey; }
std::string Model::tune_file() const { return p->tfile; }
bool Model::write_tune(const std::string& settings, std::string& err) const {
    std::vector keep;
    {
        std::ifstream f(p->tfile);
        for (std::string line; std::getline(f, line);) {
            if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
            const size_t tab = line.find('\t');
            if (!line.empty() && (tab == std::string::npos || line.compare(0, tab, p->tkey) != 0)) keep.push_back(line);
        }
    }
    keep.push_back(p->tkey + "\t" + settings);
    const std::string tmp = p->tfile + ".tmp";
    {
        std::ofstream f(tmp, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        for (const auto& l : keep) f << l << "\n";
        if (!f) {
            err = tmp + ": cannot write";
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (!strata::ds4::os::replace_file(tmp, p->tfile)) {
        err = p->tfile + ": cannot replace";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}
int Model::vocab() const { return tpe ? tpe->vocab() : p->g.vocab; }
bool Model::restore_prefix(int prefix, int mode, std::string& err) {
    if (tpe || prefix <= 0 || p->st.kv_ring <= 0) return true;
    if (prefix > p->o.max_ctx) {
        err = "KV prefix exceeds the context";
        return false;
    }
    const char* setting = ::mm3::env("MM3_KV_RESTORE");
    if (mode == 0 || (mode < 0 && setting && std::atoi(setting) == 0)) return true;
    // A valid cached prefix may live only in host memory after a longer prompt
    // wrapped the ring. Reusing its tokens alone leaves hot attention-sink rows
    // permanently on PCIe. Restore only missing rows; preserve every KV bit.
    for (const Layer& l : p->L) {
        if (l.kvh.ring <= 0) continue;
        Dev& d = p->D[(size_t) l.dev];
        CK(cudaSetDevice(d.id));
        k::kv_restore_prefix(l.kc, l.vc, l.kvq, l.kvh, prefix, p->g.n_kv, d.s);
        CK(cudaGetLastError());
    }
    return true;   // subsequent forwards use these streams, after the restores
}
size_t Model::prefix_cache_bytes(int prefix) const {
    if (tpe || p->o.seqs > 1 || prefix <= 0 || prefix > p->o.max_ctx) return 0;
    const size_t per = k::kv_bytes(p->o.kv_k, p->o.kv_v, (size_t) prefix * p->g.n_kv) +
                       (size_t) prefix * p->g.ix_dim * sizeof(uint16_t);
    return 12 * sizeof(uint64_t) + p->L.size() * per + (p->draftm ? p->draftm->cache_bytes() : 0);
}
bool Model::prefix_cache_copy(int prefix, std::vector* dst, const std::vector* src,
                              std::string& err) {
    const size_t total = prefix_cache_bytes(prefix);
    if (!total) { err = "prefix snapshots require a single layer-split sequence and a valid prefix"; return false; }
    const size_t draft = p->draftm ? p->draftm->cache_bytes() : 0;
    const std::array hdr = {{0x3148434143334d4dull, (uint64_t) prefix, p->L.size(),
        (uint64_t) p->g.n_kv, (uint64_t) p->g.ix_dim, (uint64_t) p->o.kv_k, (uint64_t) p->o.kv_v,
        (uint64_t) p->o.kv_rot, (uint64_t) p->o.max_ctx, draft, total, 0}};
    // Validate the entire layout before any model state changes. Buffers stay in this process/model.
    if (src && (src->size() != total || std::memcmp(src->data(), hdr.data(), sizeof hdr))) {
        err = "conversation snapshot layout mismatch"; return false;
    }
    if (dst) {
        try { dst->resize(total); }
        catch (const std::bad_alloc&) { err = "conversation snapshot does not fit in RAM"; return false; }
        std::memcpy(dst->data(), hdr.data(), sizeof hdr);
    }
    for (const auto& d : p->D) { CK(cudaSetDevice(d.id)); CK(cudaStreamSynchronize(d.s)); }
    size_t at = sizeof hdr;
    const auto copy = [&](void* a, size_t n, bool host) -> bool {
        if (!n) return true;
        if (dst) {
            if (host) std::memcpy(dst->data() + at, a, n);
            else { CK(cudaMemcpy(dst->data() + at, a, n, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost)); }
        } else {
            if (host) std::memcpy(a, src->data() + at, n);
            else { CK(cudaMemcpy(a, src->data() + at, n, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice)); }
        }
        at += n;
        return true;
    };
    const size_t rows = (size_t) prefix * p->g.n_kv;
    for (auto& l : p->L) {
        CK(cudaSetDevice(p->D[(size_t) l.dev].id));
        const bool host = l.kvh.ring > 0;
        const auto& q = host ? l.kvh.q : l.kvq;
        if (q.kf == k::kKvBf16) {
            if (!copy(host ? l.kvh.kc : l.kc, rows * k::kv_code_bytes(q.kf), host)) return false;
        } else if (!copy(q.kc, rows * k::kv_code_bytes(q.kf), host) ||
                   !copy(q.ks, rows * k::kv_scale_bytes(q.kf), host)) return false;
        if (q.vf == k::kKvBf16) {
            if (!copy(host ? l.kvh.vc : l.vc, rows * k::kv_code_bytes(q.vf), host)) return false;
        } else if (!copy(q.vc, rows * k::kv_code_bytes(q.vf), host) ||
                   !copy(q.vs, rows * k::kv_scale_bytes(q.vf), host)) return false;
        if (!copy(l.ic, (size_t) prefix * p->g.ix_dim * sizeof(uint16_t), false)) return false;
        if (src && host) {
            // The ring still contains another conversation: invalidate every tag, then copy exact host rows.
            auto& d = p->D[(size_t) l.dev];
            CK(cudaMemsetAsync(l.kvh.tag, 0xff, (size_t) l.kvh.ring * sizeof(int), d.s));
            k::kv_restore_prefix(l.kc, l.vc, l.kvq, l.kvh, prefix, p->g.n_kv, d.s);
            CK(cudaGetLastError());
        }
    }
    if (draft && !(dst ? p->draftm->cache_save(dst->data() + at, draft, err)
                      : p->draftm->cache_load(src->data() + at, draft, err))) return false;
    for (const auto& d : p->D) { CK(cudaSetDevice(d.id)); CK(cudaStreamSynchronize(d.s)); }
    if (src) p->cur_pos = prefix - 1;
    return true;
}

bool Model::save_profile(const std::string& path, std::string& err) const {
    if (tpe) return tpe->save_profile(path, err);
    // (the host-free layers' routings were counted on their GPUs: added in)
    std::vector all = p->prof, dc(all.size());
    for (const auto& d : p->D) {
        if (d.prof_d == nullptr) continue;
        cudaSetDevice(d.id);
        if (cudaMemcpy(dc.data(), d.prof_d, dc.size() * 4, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost) != cudaSuccess) {
            cudaGetLastError();
            err = "the expert profile's device counts not read";
            return false;
        }
        for (size_t i = 0; i < all.size(); ++i) all[i] += dc[i];
    }
    std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!f || std::fwrite(all.data(), 4, all.size(), f) != all.size()) {
        if (f) std::fclose(f);
        err = path + ": cannot write";
        return false;
    }
    std::fclose(f);
    return true;
}

bool Model::forward(const int* ids, int n, int pos0, int want, float* logits_out, std::string& err) {
    if (tpe) return tpe->forward(ids, n, pos0, want, logits_out, err);
    p->last_done = 0;
    want = std::min(want, n);
    const int C = p->run_chunk();
    for (int a = 0; a < n; a += C) {
        const int T = std::min(C, n - a);
        // the logits this chunk owns: the call's last `want` positions that fall in it
        const int first = n - want;
        const int w0 = std::max(first, a), w1 = a + T;
        const int w = logits_out && w1 > w0 ? w1 - w0 : 0;
        if (w > 0 && w0 != a + T - w) {
            err = "internal: logits rows";
            return false;
        }
        if (!p->chunk(ids + a, T, pos0 + a, w, w > 0 ? logits_out + (size_t) (w0 - first) * p->g.vocab : nullptr,
                      err))
            return false;
    }
    p->last_done = n;
    return true;
}

bool Model::forward_rows(const int* ids, const int* seq, const int* pos, int R, float* logits_out, std::string& err) {
    if (R <= 0) return true;
    if (pipe_busy() > 0) {
        err = "forward_rows: groups in the pipeline (pipe_take them first)";
        return false;
    }
    for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r)
        if (seq[r] < 0 || seq[r] >= seqs() || std::find(seq, seq + r, seq[r]) != seq + r) {
            err = "forward_rows: sequence " + std::to_string(seq[r]) + " (" + std::to_string(seqs()) +
                  " of them, each in one row at most)";
            return false;
        }
    // (one at a time where the batched step does not apply: one row, the prompt path's tokens - --no-fast-decode)
    if (tpe || R == 1 || R > kWin || !p->o.fast_decode) {
        for (int r = 0; r < R; ++r) {
            bind(seq[r]);
            if (!forward(ids + r, 1, pos[r], 1, logits_out + (size_t) r * vocab(), err)) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    p->rseq.assign(seq, seq + R);
    p->rpos.assign(pos, pos + R);
    p->last_done = 0;
    const bool ok = p->chunk(ids, R, 0, R, logits_out, err);
    p->rseq.clear();
    p->rpos.clear();
    if (ok) p->last_done = R;
    return ok;
}

// The same model as Glm5Model::step_layers (the correctness-first reference, STRATA_GLM_SLOW=1), run
// as ~11 fused launches per layer (strata/kernels/glm_fast.hpp) on a private non-blocking stream per
// device, with NO host synchronisation inside a token except where an expert is missing:
//
//   * every weight pointer is resolved once at load (no string lookups per layer per token);
//   * the router runs on the device and looks its experts up in a DEVICE table (layer x expert ->
//     VRAM slot pointer); an all-resident layer never waits for the host;
//   * every route is published to a host-mapped ring; a per-device SERVICE thread keeps the LFU
//     counts and, when a route has misses, reads the missing experts from the shards (pread into
//     pinned staging, in parallel), DMAs them into victim slots OF THAT LAYER on a copy stream and
//     answers through host-mapped memory - the device spins in a one-block wait kernel meanwhile.
//
// Victims come only from the requesting layer's own slot partition, so no kernel can be reading a
// slot while it is overwritten: the device is parked in that layer's wait kernel, the layer's

// NON_LOCAL is the process's WDDM system-memory budget, not free VRAM.
// Match CUDA's adapter by LUID; adapter 0 need not be the CUDA device.
static bool glm_pin_budget(int device, uint64_t& budget, uint64_t& usage) {
#if defined(_WIN32) && !defined(STRATA_USE_HIP)
    cudaDeviceProp prop{};
    if (cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, device) != cudaSuccess) {
        cudaGetLastError();
        return false;
    }
    IDXGIFactory1* factory = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(CreateDXGIFactory1(IID_PPV_ARGS(&factory)))) return false;
    bool found = false;
    for (UINT i = 0; !found; ++i) {
        IDXGIAdapter1* adapter = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(factory->EnumAdapters1(i, &adapter))) break;
        DXGI_ADAPTER_DESC1 desc{};
        if (SUCCEEDED(adapter->GetDesc1(&desc)) && std::memcmp(&desc.AdapterLuid, prop.luid, sizeof prop.luid) == 0) {
            IDXGIAdapter3* a3 = nullptr;
            if (SUCCEEDED(adapter->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&a3)))) {
                DXGI_QUERY_VIDEO_MEMORY_INFO info{};
                if (SUCCEEDED(a3->QueryVideoMemoryInfo(0, DXGI_MEMORY_SEGMENT_GROUP_NON_LOCAL, &info))) {
                    budget = info.Budget;
                    usage = info.CurrentUsage;
                    found = true;
                }
                a3->Release();
            }
        }
        adapter->Release();
    }
    factory->Release();
    return found;
#else
    (void) device;
    (void) budget;
    (void) usage;
    return false;
#endif
}

// Keeps the GPU out of its idle P-state for ns nanoseconds.  A consumer card at P8 drops its PCIe link (Gen1 on an
// RTX 4070 Ti SUPER / 5070 Ti), and copies alone do not wake it, so a link timed at idle reads 3-8x slower than it
// runs during decode (Tesla cards keep the link up, so this never showed there).
static __global__ void glm_link_wake(unsigned long long ns) {
#if defined(STRATA_USE_HIP)
    // no PTX %globaltimer on AMD: wall_clock64() is the constant 100 MHz counter (10 ns a tick) on gfx11 / gfx12, and
    // a wake-up spin needs no exact timing (from @boxwrench, #24)
    const long long t0 = wall_clock64();
    const long long ticks = (long long) (ns / 10ull);
    while (wall_clock64() - t0 < ticks) {
    }
#else
    unsigned long long t0, t;
    asm volatile("mov.u64 %0, %%globaltimer;" : "=l"(t0));
    do {
        asm volatile("mov.u64 %0, %%globaltimer;" : "=l"(t));
    } while (t - t0 < ns);
#endif
}

// the spec path's head group is the parts [0, h) with h = half the split (STRATA_GLM_SPEC_HEAD= overrides), the
// TAIL GROUP the rest.  fast_setup asks for h alone: it runs before the parts are linked (split_next_ is set after
// every part has loaded), so it counts them instead of walking the chain.
static int spec_head_parts(int n) {
    int h = n / 2;
    if (const char* e = getenv("STRATA_GLM_SPEC_HEAD")) h = std::atoi(e);
    return std::max(1, std::min(n - 1, h));
}

// The NUMA nodes this machine has (sysfs "online" list), and the most of this process's CPUs on any one of them;
// {} / 0 when unknown or on a single node.
static std::vector numa_nodes() {
    std::vector nodes;
#ifdef __linux__
    std::string list;
    std::ifstream("/sys/devices/system/node/online") >> list;
    std::stringstream ss(list);
    std::string r;
    while (std::getline(ss, r, ',')) {
        const size_t d = r.find('-');
        const int a = std::atoi(r.c_str()), b = d == std::string::npos ? a : std::atoi(r.c_str() + d + 1);
        for (int n = a; n <= b && n < 256; ++n) nodes.push_back(n);
    }
#endif
    return nodes;
}

// this process's CPUs (its affinity mask) by NUMA node: {node, CPUs}, node by node - one group (node -1) without NUMA
static std::vector>> cpu_groups() {
    std::vector>> out;
#ifdef __linux__
    cpu_set_t set;
    CPU_ZERO(&set);
    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof set, &set) != 0) return out;
    for (int n : numa_nodes()) {
        std::string list;
        std::ifstream("/sys/devices/system/node/node" + std::to_string(n) + "/cpulist") >> list;
        std::stringstream ss(list);
        std::string r;
        std::vector cpus;
        while (std::getline(ss, r, ',')) {
            const size_t d = r.find('-');
            const int a = std::atoi(r.c_str()), b = d == std::string::npos ? a : std::atoi(r.c_str() + d + 1);
            for (int c = a; c <= b && c < CPU_SETSIZE; ++c)
                if (CPU_ISSET(c, &set)) cpus.push_back(c);
        }
        if (!cpus.empty()) out.push_back({n, std::move(cpus)});
    }
    if (out.empty()) {
        std::vector cpus;
        for (int c = 0; c < CPU_SETSIZE; ++c)
            if (CPU_ISSET(c, &set)) cpus.push_back(c);
        if (!cpus.empty()) out.push_back({-1, std::move(cpus)});
    }
#endif
    return out;
}

// this process's CPUs by L3 cache (a Ryzen's CCDs on one NUMA node): {index, CPUs}, empty without the sysfs entries
static std::vector>> cpu_l3_groups() {
    std::vector>> out;
#ifdef __linux__
    cpu_set_t set;
    CPU_ZERO(&set);
    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof set, &set) != 0) return out;
    std::vector seen;
    for (int c = 0; c < CPU_SETSIZE; ++c) {
        if (!CPU_ISSET(c, &set)) continue;
        std::string list;
        std::ifstream("/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu" + std::to_string(c) + "/cache/index3/shared_cpu_list") >> list;
        if (list.empty()) return {};
        const auto it = std::find(seen.begin(), seen.end(), list);
        if (it == seen.end()) {
            seen.push_back(list);
            out.push_back({(int) out.size(), {c}});
        } else {
            out[(size_t) (it - seen.begin())].second.push_back(c);
        }
    }
#endif
    return out;
}

// a CPU's physical core (package, core id): its SMT siblings share it
static std::pair cpu_core(int cpu) {
    int pkg = cpu, core = cpu;
#ifdef __linux__
    const std::string t = "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu" + std::to_string(cpu) + "/topology/";
    std::ifstream(t + "physical_package_id") >> pkg;
    std::ifstream(t + "core_id") >> core;
#endif
    return {pkg, core};
}

// the NUMA node a GPU hangs off (sysfs, by its PCI address), -1 when unknown (a VM, or no NUMA)
static int gpu_numa_node(int dev) {
    int node = -1;
#ifdef __linux__
    char bus[32] = {0};
    if (cudaDeviceGetPCIBusId(bus, (int) sizeof bus, dev) != cudaSuccess) {

// Part `part` of a split across `n` GPUs (`gpu_node`: each part's GPU's NUMA node): the CPUs its pool runs on - no
// other part's, on any machine - with the node it is on (-1: none known) and how many of them to leave free.  Whole
// NUMA nodes while there are as many as parts: each part on its GPU's node when the GPUs hang off distinct nodes,
// else part i on node i.  With fewer nodes than parts (one socket), the parts on a node share it out in runs of whole
// physical cores (SMT siblings together).  The 4 CPUs a node keeps free (the main thread's event wait, the service
// and warm-up threads, as one GPU's pool leaves) are shared by its parts.  {} with nothing to give.
static std::vector part_cpus(int part, int n, const std::vector& gpu_node, int& node, int& spare) {
    const auto groups = cpu_groups();
    node = -1;
    spare = 4;
    if (groups.empty() || n < 1 || part < 0 || part >= n) return {};
    const int G = (int) groups.size();
    std::vector grp((size_t) n);
    bool by_gpu = n <= G && (int) gpu_node.size() == n;
    std::vector taken((size_t) G, false);
    for (int i = 0; by_gpu && i < n; ++i) {
        int at = -1;
        for (int j = 0; j < G; ++j)
            if (groups[(size_t) j].first >= 0 && groups[(size_t) j].first == gpu_node[(size_t) i]) at = j;
        by_gpu = at >= 0 && !taken[(size_t) at];
        if (by_gpu) {
            taken[(size_t) at] = true;
            grp[(size_t) i] = at;
        }
    }
    if (!by_gpu)
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) grp[(size_t) i] = i % G;
    int k = 0, slot = 0;   // the parts on this part's node, and this part's place among them
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        if (grp[(size_t) i] == grp[(size_t) part]) {
            if (i == part) slot = k;
            ++k;
        }
    const auto& g = groups[(size_t) grp[(size_t) part]];
    node = g.first;
    spare = (4 + k - 1) / k;
    if (k == 1) return g.second;
    std::vector, int>> by_core;
    for (int c : g.second) by_core.push_back({cpu_core(c), c});
    std::sort(by_core.begin(), by_core.end());
    std::vector> cores;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < by_core.size(); ++i) {
        if (i == 0 || by_core[i].first != by_core[i - 1].first) cores.emplace_back();
        cores.back().push_back(by_core[i].second);
    }
    std::vector out;
    const size_t a = cores.size() * (size_t) slot / (size_t) k, b = cores.size() * (size_t) (slot + 1) / (size_t) k;
    for (size_t j = a; j < b; ++j) out.insert(out.end(), cores[j].begin(), cores[j].end());
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
    return out;
}

static int numa_node_cpus() {
    int best = 0;
    for (const auto& c : numa_node_cpu_lists()) best = std::max(best, (int) c.size());
    return best;
}

// The RAM tier's pinned memory spread page by page over every NUMA node: mmap + mbind(MPOL_INTERLEAVE) (+ transparent
// huge pages), then cudaHostRegister - the pages are placed when the registration faults them in, so the policy
// holds.  cudaHostAlloc's pages come from the driver node by node whatever the thread's policy (a 112 GB tier: 57.6 GB
// on one node, 72.7 GB on the other, each expert on ONE of them), and the CPU lane reads every expert with all its
// threads through that node's memory controllers only (2-socket Xeon, Q3_K experts, 44 threads: 216 us an expert
// node-local, 152 us interleaved).  Mapped, so the device reads its host pointers as it does cudaHostAlloc's.
// nullptr: one node, STRATA_GLM_NUMA=0, no host-pointer access for registered memory, or a failure.
static void* numa_pinned(size_t bytes) {
#ifdef __linux__
    const char* v = getenv("STRATA_GLM_NUMA");
    const auto nodes = numa_nodes();
    if ((v != nullptr && std::atoi(v) == 0) || nodes.size() < 2) return nullptr;
    int dev = 0, ok = 0;
    cudaGetDevice(&dev);
    if (cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&ok, cudaDevAttrCanUseHostPointerForRegisteredMem, dev) != cudaSuccess || !ok) {
        cudaGetLastError();
        return nullptr;
    }
    void* p = mmap(nullptr, bytes, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_NORESERVE, -1, 0);
    if (p == MAP_FAILED) return nullptr;
    unsigned long mask[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
    for (int n : nodes) mask[n / 64] |= 1ul << (n % 64);
    // huge pages only while free 2 MB blocks cover the tier (/proc/buddyinfo, orders 9 and up): otherwise every 2 MB
    // fault of a MADV_HUGEPAGE region compacts memory on the spot (transparent_hugepage/defrag "madvise") and mostly
    // fails - a split's second card, pinning its tier after the first card's had taken most of the RAM and the page
    // cache the rest (0.28 GB left in 2 MB blocks), sat in the kernel for over 10 minutes at ~10 MB/s.  4 KB pages
    // reclaim the cache as they fault in (the CPU lane reads them 6-8% slower than huge ones)
    size_t huge_free = 0;
    bool huge_known = false;
    if (FILE* bf = std::fopen("/proc/buddyinfo", "r")) {
        char line[512];
        while (std::fgets(line, sizeof line, bf)) {
            const char* z = std::strstr(line, "zone");
            if (z == nullptr) continue;
            z += 4;
            while (*z == ' ') ++z;
            while (*z != ' ' && *z != '\0') ++z;   // the zone's name
            unsigned long long c[16] = {};
            int k = 0;
            char* end = nullptr;
            for (const char* q = z; k < 16; ++k, q = end) {
                c[k] = std::strtoull(q, &end, 10);
                if (end == q) break;
            }
            for (int o = 9; o < k; ++o) huge_free += (size_t) c[o] << (o + 12);
            huge_known = true;
        }
        std::fclose(bf);
    }
    if (!huge_known || huge_free >= bytes + ((size_t) 1 << 30)) madvise(p, bytes, MADV_HUGEPAGE);
    // (the registration faults the pages in, one thread: faulting them from 16 threads first started ~40 s sooner but
    // left fewer huge pages - the CPU lane read its experts 6-8% slower, 2-socket Xeon 6152)
    // fault in before registering: cudaHostRegister holds the driver lock, stalling other parts' copies
    if (syscall(SYS_mbind, p, bytes, 3 /* MPOL_INTERLEAVE */, mask, (unsigned long) (sizeof mask * 8), 0u) != 0) {
        munmap(p, bytes);
        return nullptr;
    }
    for (size_t o = 0; o < bytes; o += 4096) ((volatile char*) p)[o] = 0;
    if (cudaHostRegister(p, bytes, cudaHostRegisterPortable | cudaHostRegisterMapped) != cudaSuccess) {
        cudaGetLastError();
        munmap(p, bytes);
        return nullptr;
    }
    return p;
#else
    (void) bytes;
    return nullptr;
#endif
}

#ifdef _WIN32
// the NUMA node most of [p, p + bytes) physically sits on (-1 unknown).  On a 2-socket host
// a cudaHostAlloc tier lands on one side or the other as a start-to-start lottery, and the
// side it picks sets the whole run's decode: the GPU fetches every RAM-tier expert over PCIe,
// and from the far node those fetches cross the inter-socket link (#56: 0.73 ms an expert with
// the tier on the GPU's node against 0.86 on the other one, ~30% tok/s on a 2-socket Xeon +
// one V100; single- and many-thread plain reads are symmetric, so it is the DMA path).
// Windows offers no way to place a range this size (VirtualAllocExNuma honors its node only
// for fresh whole allocations - a tier larger than a node cannot have one - and committing a
// reserved range or first-touching pages follows no node), so this only makes the lottery
// visible: the log line tells which mode a start drew, and a launcher may restart on it.
static int win_arena_node(const void* p, size_t bytes) {
    using QWSE_t = BOOL (WINAPI*)(HANDLE, PVOID, DWORD);
    static QWSE_t qwse = []() -> QWSE_t {
        HMODULE k32 = GetModuleHandleW(L"kernel32.dll");
        return k32 ? (QWSE_t) (void*) GetProcAddress(k32, "K32QueryWorkingSetEx") : nullptr;
    }();
    if (qwse == nullptr || p == nullptr || bytes < 4096) return -1;
    const size_t pages = bytes / 4096, step = pages / 512 ? pages / 512 : 1;   // ~512 samples
    unsigned long long hits[64] = {};
    unsigned char buf[16 * 64];
    int total = 0;
    for (size_t chunk = 0; chunk * 64 * step < pages; ++chunk) {
        DWORD n = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 64 && (chunk * 64 + i) * step < pages; ++i, ++n) {
            const ULONG64 a = ((ULONG64) p) + (ULONG64) ((chunk * 64 + i) * step * 4096);
            memcpy(buf + i * 16, &a, 8);
        }
        if (n == 0 || !qwse(GetCurrentProcess(), buf, DWORD(n * 16))) break;
        for (DWORD i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if ((buf[i * 16 + 8] & 1) == 0) continue;   // invalid
            const int node = (int) (buf[i * 16 + 10] & 0x3f);   // Node: bits 16..21 (19H1+ layout; 22, 23: Locked, LargePage)
            if (node >= 0 && node < 64) { hits[node]++; total++; }
        }
    }
    if (total < 32) return -1;
    int best = -1;
    for (int n = 0; n < 64; ++n)
        if (best < 0 || hits[n] > hits[best]) best = n;
    return best >= 0 && hits[best] * 4 > (unsigned long long) total * 3 ? best : -1;   // 75% majority
}
#endif

int64_t glmfast::zfs_arc_reclaimable() {
#ifdef __linux__
    FILE* f = std::fopen("/proc/spl/kstat/zfs/arcstats", "r");   // (rows "name type value" after two header lines)
    if (f == nullptr) return 0;
    long long size = -1, cmin = -1;
    char line[256], name[64];
    while (std::fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        int type = 0;
        long long v = 0;
        if (std::sscanf(line, "%63s %d %lld", name, &type, &v) != 3) continue;
        if (std::strcmp(name, "size") == 0) size = v;
        else if (std::strcmp(name, "c_min") == 0) cmin = v;
    }
    std::fclose(f);
    return size > 0 && cmin >= 0 && size > cmin ? (int64_t) (size - cmin) : 0;
#else
    return 0;
#endif
}

// the RAM free now: MemAvailable and ZFS's reclaimable ARC (Windows: the smaller of the free RAM and the free commit,
// which pinning is charged to); 0 when unknown
static int64_t avail_ram_now() {
#ifdef _WIN32
    MEMORYSTATUSEX ms{};
    ms.dwLength = sizeof ms;
    return GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&ms) ? (int64_t) std::min(ms.ullAvailPhys, ms.ullAvailPageFile) : 0;
#else
    long long kb = 0;
    if (FILE* f = std::fopen("/proc/meminfo", "r")) {
        char line[256];
        while (std::fgets(line, sizeof line, f))
            if (std::sscanf(line, "MemAvailable: %lld kB", &kb) == 1) break;
        std::fclose(f);
    }
    return kb > 0 ? (int64_t) kb * 1024 + glmfast::zfs_arc_reclaimable() : 0;
#endif
}

static void numa_pinned_free(void* p, size_t bytes) {
#ifdef __linux__
    cudaHostUnregister(p);
    munmap(p, bytes);
#else
    (void) p;
    (void) bytes;
#endif
}

// The RAM tier's sizing pins through these: STRATA_GLM_PIN_CAP_MB= (tests) refuses what would take the bytes they
// hold past it - a Windows pinning cap where there is none.  (The parts of a split pin one after another.)
static int64_t g_pin_held = 0;
static cudaError_t pin_alloc(void** p, size_t bytes, unsigned flags) {
    static const int64_t cap = getenv("STRATA_GLM_PIN_CAP_MB") ? std::atoll(getenv("STRATA_GLM_PIN_CAP_MB")) << 20 : -1;
    if (cap >= 0 && g_pin_held + (int64_t) bytes > cap) return cudaErrorMemoryAllocation;
    const cudaError_t e = cudaHostAlloc(p, bytes, flags);
    if (e == cudaSuccess) g_pin_held += (int64_t) bytes;
    return e;
}
static void pin_free(void* p, size_t bytes) {
    cudaFreeHost(p);
    g_pin_held -= (int64_t) bytes;
}
constexpr size_t kPinRoom = (size_t) 512 << 20;   // what a tier leaves pinnable above it (the driver's own buffers)

// How much more pins now, up to `limit` bytes: probes of 1 GB, then of 256 MB, until one is refused (freed again).
// Measured at a pinning cap's first refusal, it sizes the tier's classes from there on: the steps down (3%, then 12%)
// landed up to a step under the cap, and the slots left under it held experts the disk then served (a Windows PC with
// 128 GB: the tier 2.5 GB under its cap, 6-13 disk reads a token instead of 0.5-1, decode 11-18 tok/s instead of
// 18-23 - #129)
static int64_t pin_room(int64_t limit) {
    std::vector> probes;
    int64_t got = 0;
    for (const size_t probe : {(size_t) 1 << 30, (size_t) 256 << 20})
        for (void* q = nullptr; got + (int64_t) probe <= limit; q = nullptr) {
            if (pin_alloc(&q, probe, cudaHostAllocDefault) != cudaSuccess) {
                cudaGetLastError();
                break;
            }
            probes.push_back({q, probe});
            got += (int64_t) probe;
        }
    for (const auto& [q, bytes] : probes) pin_free(q, bytes);
    return got;
}


// a start-time upload of pageable host data through a pinned buffer of ours (the disk staging): a pageable copy needs
// pinned buffers of the driver's own, and with the RAM tiers just under a pinning cap (Windows) the warmed tables'
// upload found none and stopped the start (#105).  No staging: the plain copy
static cudaError_t upload_staged(uint8_t* stage, size_t stage_bytes, void* dst, const void* src, size_t bytes) {
    if (stage == nullptr || stage_bytes == 0) return cudaMemcpy(dst, src, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    cudaError_t e = cudaSuccess;
    for (size_t o = 0; e == cudaSuccess && o < bytes; o += stage_bytes) {
        const size_t len = std::min(stage_bytes, bytes - o);
        std::memcpy(stage, (const uint8_t*) src + o, len);
        e = cudaMemcpy((uint8_t*) dst + o, stage, len, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    }
    return e;
}

namespace glmfast {

// [off, off + len) of a shard into dst: O_DIRECT through an aligned per-thread bounce buffer when the shard has a
// direct fd (no page cache), a buffered pread otherwise, the mapping as the last resort
void read_slice(const Glm5Model::Shard& sh, uint64_t off, size_t len, uint8_t* dst) {
#ifndef _WIN32
    if (sh.fd_direct >= 0) {
        // freed when its thread ends
        struct Bounce {
            uint8_t* p = nullptr;
            size_t cap = 0;
            ~Bounce() { std::free(p); }
        };
        static thread_local Bounce bb;
        uint8_t*& bounce = bb.p;
        size_t& cap = bb.cap;
        const uint64_t a0 = off & ~(uint64_t) 4095, a1 = (off + len + 4095) & ~(uint64_t) 4095;
        const size_t need = (size_t) (a1 - a0);
        if (cap < need) {
            std::free(bounce);
            bounce = (uint8_t*) std::aligned_alloc(4096, need);
            cap = bounce ? need : 0;
        }
        if (bounce != nullptr) {
            size_t got = 0;
            while (got < need) {
                const ssize_t r = pread(sh.fd_direct, bounce + got, need - got, (off_t) (a0 + got));
                if (r <= 0) break;   // EOF: the last aligned read is short where the file ends
                got += (size_t) r;
            }
            if (got >= (size_t) (off - a0) + len) {
                std::memcpy(dst, bounce + (off - a0), len);
                return;
            }
        }
    }
    size_t done = 0;
    while (done < len) {
        const ssize_t r = pread(sh.fd, dst + done, len - done, (off_t) (off + done));
        if (r <= 0) {
            std::memcpy(dst + done, sh.base + off + done, len - done);
            return;
        }
        done += (size_t) r;
    }
#else
    // Windows: the unbuffered handle the same way (sector-aligned offset, size and buffer), the mapping otherwise.
    // The handle is overlapped (reads from many threads run at once): each read waits on this thread's own event
    if (sh.h_direct != nullptr) {
        // freed and closed when its thread ends
        struct Bounce {
            uint8_t* p = nullptr;
            size_t cap = 0;
            HANDLE ev = CreateEventA(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, nullptr);
            ~Bounce() {
                _aligned_free(p);
                if (ev != nullptr) CloseHandle(ev);
            }
        };
        static thread_local Bounce bb;
        uint8_t*& bounce = bb.p;
        size_t& cap = bb.cap;
        const HANDLE done_ev = bb.ev;
        const uint64_t a0 = off & ~(uint64_t) 4095, a1 = (off + len + 4095) & ~(uint64_t) 4095;
        const size_t need = (size_t) (a1 - a0);
        if (cap < need) {
            _aligned_free(bounce);
            bounce = (uint8_t*) _aligned_malloc(need, 4096);
            cap = bounce ? need : 0;
        }
        if (bounce != nullptr && done_ev != nullptr) {
            size_t got = 0;
            while (got < need) {
                OVERLAPPED ov{};
                const uint64_t at = a0 + got;
                ov.Offset = (DWORD) at;
                ov.OffsetHigh = (DWORD) (at >> 32);
                ov.hEvent = done_ev;
                const DWORD want = (DWORD) std::min(need - got, (size_t) 1 << 30);
                DWORD r = 0;
                if (!ReadFile((HANDLE) sh.h_direct, bounce + got, want, nullptr, &ov) &&
                    GetLastError() != ERROR_IO_PENDING) break;   // EOF: the last aligned read is short
                if (!GetOverlappedResult((HANDLE) sh.h_direct, &ov, &r, TRUE) || r == 0) break;
                got += (size_t) r;
            }
            if (got >= (size_t) (off - a0) + len) {
                std::memcpy(dst, bounce + (off - a0), len);
                return;
            }
        }
    }
    if (sh.base == nullptr) {   // the views went after the load (pack_release_views): nothing to fall back to
        std::fprintf(stderr, "glm fast: an expert read of %s failed (error %lu) - MAYA_GLM_KEEP_MAP=1 keeps the "
                             "mapping to fall back to\n", sh.path.c_str(), (unsigned long) GetLastError());
        std::abort();
    }
    std::memcpy(dst, sh.base + off, len);
#endif
}

}  // namespace glmfast

using glmfast::read_slice;

static float* fa_take(uint8_t*& at, size_t floats) {
    float* p = (float*) at;
    at += (floats * sizeof(float) + 255u) & ~(size_t) 255u;
    return p;
}
static void* fa_take_b(uint8_t*& at, size_t bytes) {
    void* p = at;
    at += (bytes + 255u) & ~(size_t) 255u;
    return p;
}

bool Glm5Model::fast_setup(std::string& err) {
    cudaSetDevice(dev_);
    auto* F = new FastState();
    fast_ = F;
    F->hip_vram_only=getenv("STRATA_GLM_HIP_VRAM_ONLY") && std::atoi(getenv("STRATA_GLM_HIP_VRAM_ONLY"))!=0;
    F->hip_tail_cache=F->hip_vram_only && (!getenv("STRATA_GLM_HIP_TAIL_CACHE") || std::atoi(getenv("STRATA_GLM_HIP_TAIL_CACHE"))!=0);
    F->hip_cache_backups=F->hip_tail_cache && getenv("STRATA_GLM_HIP_CACHE_BACKUPS") && std::atoi(getenv("STRATA_GLM_HIP_CACHE_BACKUPS"))!=0;
    if(const char* v=getenv("STRATA_GLM_HIP_CACHE_CHECK"))F->hip_cache_check_left=std::max(0,std::atoi(v));
    // Not on Windows: there an APU's GPU memory is a fixed carve-out (AMD's Variable Graphics Memory, or the BIOS)
    // that Windows does not count as RAM, so it is sized like a discrete card - the pool from what the runtime reports
    // free, the RAM tier from the free RAM and commit (below).  On Linux an integrated device's memory IS the system's
    // (Ryzen AI Max APUs, and GB10 / Grace on CUDA): the pool is sized from the RAM that is actually available.
#if !defined(_WIN32)
    int integrated = 0;
    if (cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&integrated, cudaDevAttrIntegrated, dev_) == cudaSuccess)
        F->unified_memory = integrated != 0;
    else
        cudaGetLastError();
#endif
    const Glm5Geometry& g = g_;
    F->timing = getenv("STRATA_GLM_TIMING") != nullptr;
    F->prof_on = getenv("STRATA_GLM_PROF") != nullptr;
    if (F->prof_on) F->pskip = (uint64_t) std::max(0, std::atoi(getenv("STRATA_GLM_PROF")));
    if (const char* pn = getenv("STRATA_GLM_PREFETCH_N")) {
        F->max_pf = std::max(0, std::min(gf::kSpares - 1, std::atoi(pn)));
        // said at start: the prefetch's settings are read once and nothing else shows them (#6)
        if (F->max_pf > 0) {
            const char* at = getenv("STRATA_GLM_PREFETCH_AT");
            const char* bl = getenv("STRATA_GLM_PREFETCH_BLOCKS");
            const char* rk = getenv("STRATA_GLM_PREFETCH_RANK");
            std::fprintf(stderr, "glm fast: CUDA%d prefetch on: up to %d of the next layer's predicted experts a layer%s, "
                                 "the copy at %s, %s blocks, %s\n", dev_, F->max_pf,
                         std::atoi(pn) > F->max_pf ? " (MAYA_GLM_PREFETCH_N is at most 2)" : "",
                         at != nullptr && (std::strcmp(at, "fetch") == 0 || std::strcmp(at, "cpu") == 0) ? at : "route",
                         bl != nullptr ? bl : "half the SMs'",
                         rk != nullptr ? (std::string("prediction ranks 1-") + rk).c_str() : "any prediction rank");
        }
    }
    // RAM-resident mode (--glm-ram-resident / STRATA_GLM_RAM_RESIDENT=1): the RAM tier's per-class cap grows by
    // ram_slack slots per MoE layer so it holds EVERY expert VRAM does not; nothing is ever dropped to disk and the
    // start fails when the tier cannot hold them all - the disk is the pack's home, never a read source at runtime
    F->ram_resident = getenv("STRATA_GLM_RAM_RESIDENT") != nullptr && std::atoi(getenv("STRATA_GLM_RAM_RESIDENT")) != 0;
    if (const char* rs = getenv("STRATA_GLM_RAM_SLACK")) F->ram_slack = std::max(0, std::atoi(rs));
    else if (F->ram_resident) F->ram_slack = 16;
    if (cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&F->cs, cudaStreamNonBlocking) != cudaSuccess ||
        cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&F->copy, cudaStreamNonBlocking) != cudaSuccess ||
        cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&F->ps, cudaStreamNonBlocking) != cudaSuccess ||
        cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&F->ev_hop, cudaEventDisableTiming) != cudaSuccess ||
        cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&F->ev_pred, cudaEventDisableTiming) != cudaSuccess ||
        cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&F->ev_pf, cudaEventDisableTiming) != cudaSuccess ||
        cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&F->ev_pf_prev, cudaEventDisableTiming) != cudaSuccess ||
        cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&F->ev_done, cudaEventDisableTiming) != cudaSuccess) {
        err = "glm fast: streams/events did not create";
        return false;
    }
    // an EXL3 pack: its kernels' scratch on the compute stream now (a graph capture cannot allocate it)
    if (exl3_ && !strata::kernels::exl3::prepare(F->cs)) {
        err = "glm fast: the EXL3 scratch did not allocate";
        return false;
    }

    // ---- the weights, resolved once
    const int NL = g.n_layers + 1;   // every per-layer table: the trunk + the NextN block's slot
    F->L.assign((size_t) NL, FastState::Layer{});
    std::string missing;
    for (int il = l0_; il < lt_; ++il) {
        const bool is_mtp = il == mtp_il_;
        auto& Ly = F->L[(size_t) il];
        const std::string P = "blk." + std::to_string(il) + ".";
        const auto f32 = [&](const char* n) -> const float* {
            auto it = w_.find(P + n);
            if (it == w_.end()) { missing += P + n + " (f32) "; return nullptr; }
            return it->second;
        };
        const auto b16 = [&](const char* n) -> const uint16_t* {
            auto it = w16_.find(P + n);
            if (it == w16_.end()) { missing += P + n + " (bf16) "; return nullptr; }
            return it->second;
        };
        const auto q = [&](const char* n) -> WSlot {
            auto it = ws_map_.find(P + n);
            if (it == ws_map_.end() || it->second.type == 0 || !gf::mv_supported(it->second.type)) {
                missing += P + n + " (quant) ";
                return WSlot{};
            }
            return it->second;
        };
        // a projection a GGUF keeps unquantized (BF16 - e.g. attn_kv_a_mqa in some community GGUFs) where Maya's
        // quants quantize it: the BF16 copy; the jobs that take these pass the float activation as well
        const auto q_or_b16 = [&](const char* n, int64_t n_in, int64_t n_out) -> WSlot {
            const auto it = ws_map_.find(P + n);
            if (it == ws_map_.end() || it->second.type == 0) {
                const auto b = w16_.find(P + n);
                if (b != w16_.end()) return WSlot{nullptr, gf::kTypeBF16, b->second, n_in, n_out};
            }
            return q(n);
        };
        Ly.recr = is_mtp ? false : g.is_recr(il);
        Ly.moe = il >= g.dense_lead;
        Ly.mtp = is_mtp;
        if (is_mtp) {
            // no hyper-connections: eh_proj in, plain residuals, the shared head's norm out
            Ly.eh = q("nextn.eh_proj.weight");
            Ly.enorm = f32("nextn.enorm.weight");
            Ly.hnorm = f32("nextn.hnorm.weight");
            Ly.shnorm = f32("nextn.shared_head_norm.weight");
        } else {
            Ly.hc_attn_fn = b16("hc_attn_fn.weight");
            Ly.hc_ffn_fn = b16("hc_ffn_fn.weight");
            Ly.hc_attn_scale = f32("hc_attn_scale.weight");
            Ly.hc_attn_base = f32("hc_attn_base.weight");
            Ly.hc_ffn_scale = f32("hc_ffn_scale.weight");
            Ly.hc_ffn_base = f32("hc_ffn_base.weight");
        }
        Ly.attn_norm = f32("attn_norm.weight");
        Ly.ffn_norm = f32("ffn_norm.weight");
        if (Ly.recr) {
            Ly.q = q("attn_q.weight");
            Ly.k = q("attn_k.weight");
            Ly.v = q("attn_v.weight");
            Ly.f_a = b16("ssm_f_a.weight");
            Ly.g_a = b16("ssm_g_a.weight");
            Ly.f_b = b16("ssm_f_b.weight");
            Ly.g_b = b16("ssm_g_b.weight");
            Ly.beta = b16("ssm_beta.weight");
            Ly.conv[0] = f32("ssm_conv1d_q.weight");
            Ly.conv[1] = f32("ssm_conv1d_k.weight");
            Ly.conv[2] = f32("ssm_conv1d_v.weight");
            Ly.dt_bias = f32("ssm_dt.bias");
            Ly.ssm_a = f32("ssm_a");
            Ly.ssm_norm = f32("ssm_norm.weight");
        } else {
            Ly.q_a = q_or_b16("attn_q_a.weight", g.n_embd, g.q_lora);
            Ly.q_b = q("attn_q_b.weight");
            Ly.kv_a = q_or_b16("attn_kv_a_mqa.weight", g.n_embd, g.kv_lora);
            Ly.q_a_norm = f32("attn_q_a_norm.weight");
            Ly.kv_a_norm = f32("attn_kv_a_norm.weight");
            Ly.k_norm_w = f32("indexer.k_norm.weight");
            Ly.k_norm_b = f32("indexer.k_norm.bias");
            Ly.ape = f32("indexer_compressor_ape.weight");
            Ly.idx_k = b16("indexer.attn_k.weight");
            Ly.idx_gate = b16("indexer_compressor_gate.weight");
            if (const auto xi = ws_map_.find(P + "indexer.attn_q_b.weight");
                xi != ws_map_.end() && xi->second.type == strata::kernels::exl3::kTypeEXL3)
                Ly.idx_q_b_x = xi->second;   // an EXL3 pack quantizes it
            else
                Ly.idx_q_b = b16("indexer.attn_q_b.weight");
            Ly.idx_proj = b16("indexer.proj.weight");
            Ly.k_b = b16("attn_k_b.weight");
            Ly.v_b = b16("attn_v_b.weight");
        }
        Ly.out = q("attn_output.weight");
        if (Ly.moe) {
            Ly.router = b16("ffn_gate_inp.weight");
            Ly.router_bias = f32("exp_probs_b.bias");
            Ly.sh_gate = q("ffn_gate_shexp.weight");
            Ly.sh_up = q("ffn_up_shexp.weight");
            Ly.sh_down = q("ffn_down_shexp.weight");
            const auto& nl = pack_layers_[(size_t) il];
            if (nl.layer < 0) {
                missing += P + "native experts ";
            } else if (nl.x_cb >= 0) {
                // EXL3: the blob is [gate | up | down], a part [trellis | suh | svh]
                Ly.exl3 = true;
                Ly.gu_type = Ly.d_type = strata::kernels::exl3::kTypeEXL3;
                Ly.gu_bytes = nl.x_part(0);
                Ly.dn_bytes = nl.x_part(2);
                Ly.down_off = 2 * Ly.gu_bytes;
                Ly.blob = 2 * Ly.gu_bytes + Ly.dn_bytes;
                Ly.xl.cb = nl.x_cb;
                for (int r = 0; r < 3; ++r) {
                    const size_t base = r == 0 ? 0 : r == 1 ? Ly.gu_bytes : Ly.down_off;
                    Ly.xl.trellis[r] = base;
                    Ly.xl.suh[r] = base + nl.x_piece(r, 0);
                    Ly.xl.svh[r] = base + nl.x_piece(r, 0) + nl.x_piece(r, 1);
                    Ly.xl.k2[r] = nl.x_k2[r];
                }
            } else {
                Ly.gu_type = nl.fmt.gu_type;
                Ly.d_type = nl.fmt.d_type;
                Ly.gu_bytes = (size_t) nl.fmt.gu_row * (size_t) g.n_ff_exp;
                Ly.dn_bytes = (size_t) nl.fmt.d_row * (size_t) g.n_embd;
                Ly.down_off = 2 * Ly.gu_bytes;
                Ly.blob = 2 * Ly.gu_bytes + Ly.dn_bytes;
                if (!gf::moe_supported(Ly.gu_type) || !gf::moe_supported(Ly.d_type) ||
                    gf::row_bytes(Ly.gu_type, g.n_embd) != nl.fmt.gu_row ||
                    gf::row_bytes(Ly.d_type, g.n_ff_exp) != nl.fmt.d_row)
                    missing += P + "expert types " + std::to_string(Ly.gu_type) + "/" + std::to_string(Ly.d_type) + " ";
            }
        } else {
            Ly.ffn_gate = q("ffn_gate.weight");
            Ly.ffn_up = q("ffn_up.weight");
            Ly.ffn_down = q("ffn_down.weight");
        }
    }
    if (!missing.empty()) {
        err = "glm fast: unresolved weights: " + missing.substr(0, 600);
        return false;
    }

    // ---- the activation arena
    const int64_t E = g.n_embd, DI = g.d_inner(), FF = g.n_ff_exp * g.n_shared;
    const int64_t max_pools = std::max(1, max_ctx_ / g.idx_kpool);
    const size_t q8 = 36;   // bytes per q8_1 block
    size_t need = 0;
    {
        // generous upper bound, carved below
        need = (size_t) (4 * E + 64 + 32 * 26 + 128 + 6 * DI + 4 * 128 + 2 * DI + 2 * g.q_lora + 2 * g.kv_lora +
                         4 * g.idx_key + 64 + (int64_t) g.n_head * g.qk_nope + (int64_t) g.idx_heads * g.idx_key +
                         max_pools + g.n_sel_max() + 2 * g.n_expert + 2 * FF + 2 * g.n_ff_dense + 2 * E + 64) *
                   sizeof(float);
        need += (size_t) (E + DI + g.q_lora + (int64_t) g.n_head * g.v_head + FF + 8 * g.n_ff_exp + g.n_ff_dense + E) /
                32 * q8;
        need += 64 * 256 + (size_t) (2 * NL * g.n_expert + NL * gf::kSpares) * sizeof(unsigned long long) +
                8 * 16 + 4096 * 4 + 4 * 256 + (size_t) g.n_expert * 4 + 256 + 4 * 256;
        need += (size_t) gf::kAhead * g.n_expert * sizeof(float) + 256 + (size_t) E * sizeof(float) + 256;
        need += (size_t) g.n_sel_max() * sizeof(int) + 256;   // slot_cells
    }
    if (cudaMalloc(&F->arena, need) != cudaSuccess) {
        err = "glm fast: the activation arena did not allocate";
        return false;
    }
    cudaMemset(F->arena, 0, need);
    F->arena_bytes = need;
    uint8_t* at = (uint8_t*) F->arena;
    F->x = fa_take(at, E);
    F->mixer = fa_take(at, E);
    F->ffn = fa_take(at, E);
    F->pre = fa_take(at, 8);
    F->post = fa_take(at, 8);
    F->comb = fa_take(at, 16);
    F->part = fa_take(at, (size_t) (4 * E / 512) * 26 + 64);   // 25 partials per block + the norm's per-block sums
    F->counter = (unsigned int*) fa_take_b(at, 64);
    F->xq = fa_take_b(at, (size_t) E / 32 * q8);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) F->proj[i] = fa_take(at, DI);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) F->conv[i] = fa_take(at, DI);
    F->fa = fa_take(at, g.kda_head_dim);
    F->ga = fa_take(at, g.kda_head_dim);
    F->beta = fa_take(at, g.n_head);
    F->g1 = fa_take(at, DI);
    F->g2 = fa_take(at, DI);
    F->gated_q = fa_take_b(at, (size_t) DI / 32 * q8);
    F->qr_raw = fa_take(at, g.q_lora);
    F->qr = fa_take(at, g.q_lora);
    F->qr_q = fa_take_b(at, (size_t) g.q_lora / 32 * q8);
    F->kv_raw = fa_take(at, g.kv_lora);
    F->ik_raw = fa_take(at, g.idx_key);
    F->ig_raw = fa_take(at, g.idx_key);
    F->iw = fa_take(at, g.idx_heads);
    F->q = fa_take(at, (size_t) g.n_head * g.qk_nope);
    F->iq = fa_take(at, (size_t) g.idx_heads * g.idx_key);
    F->score = fa_take(at, (size_t) max_pools);
    F->cells = (int*) fa_take(at, (size_t) g.n_sel_max());
    F->slot_cells = (int*) fa_take(at, (size_t) g.n_sel_max());
    F->attn_q = fa_take_b(at, (size_t) g.n_head * g.v_head / 32 * q8);
    F->rlog = fa_take(at, g.n_expert);
    F->plog = fa_take(at, g.n_expert);
    F->alog = fa_take(at, (size_t) gf::kAhead * g.n_expert);
    F->sh_out = fa_take(at, E);
    F->sh_g = fa_take(at, FF);
    F->sh_u = fa_take(at, FF);
    F->sh_hq = fa_take_b(at, (size_t) FF / 32 * q8);
    F->hq = fa_take_b(at, (size_t) 8 * g.n_ff_exp / 32 * q8);
    F->dg = fa_take(at, g.n_ff_dense);
    F->du = fa_take(at, g.n_ff_dense);
    F->dhq = fa_take_b(at, (size_t) g.n_ff_dense / 32 * q8);
    F->head_x = fa_take(at, E);
    F->head_xq = fa_take_b(at, (size_t) E / 32 * q8);
    F->emb = fa_take(at, E);
    F->tok = (int*) fa_take_b(at, 64);
    F->n_keys = NL * g.n_expert;
    F->tab = (unsigned long long*) fa_take_b(
        at, (size_t) (2 * F->n_keys + NL * gf::kSpares) * sizeof(unsigned long long));
    F->md.tab = F->tab;
    F->md.n_keys = F->n_keys;
    F->md.scratch = (unsigned long long*) fa_take_b(at, 8 * sizeof(unsigned long long));
    F->md.fetch_src = (unsigned long long*) fa_take_b(at, 8 * sizeof(unsigned long long));
    for (int b2 = 0; b2 < 2; ++b2) {
        F->pf_buf[b2] = (unsigned long long*) fa_take_b(at, 16 * sizeof(unsigned long long));
        F->pf_n_buf[b2] = (int*) fa_take_b(at, 64);
    }
    F->md.plan_ptr = (unsigned long long*) fa_take_b(at, 8 * sizeof(unsigned long long));
    F->md.plan_w = fa_take(at, 8);
    F->md.plan_id = (int*) fa_take(at, 8);
    F->md.seq = (unsigned int*) fa_take_b(at, 64);
    F->md.wait_seq = (unsigned int*) fa_take_b(at, 64);
    F->md.cpu_part = fa_take(at, E);
    F->md.cpu_flag = (int*) fa_take_b(at, 64);
    if ((size_t) (at - (uint8_t*) F->arena) > need) {
        err = "glm fast: the activation arena overflowed its estimate";
        return false;
    }
    if (mtp_il_ >= 0) {
        if (cudaMalloc(&F->mtp_h, (size_t) g.n_embd * sizeof(float)) != cudaSuccess ||
            cudaMalloc(&F->mtp_catq, (size_t) 2 * g.n_embd / 32 * 36) != cudaSuccess ||
            cudaMalloc(&F->mtp_logits, (size_t) g.n_vocab * sizeof(float)) != cudaSuccess ||
            cudaMalloc(&F->mtp_tok, 64) != cudaSuccess ||
            cudaHostAlloc((void**) &F->mtp_tok_h, 64, cudaHostAllocDefault) != cudaSuccess ||
            cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&F->ev_mtp, cudaEventDisableTiming) != cudaSuccess) {
            err = "glm fast: the NextN block's buffers did not allocate";
            return false;
        }
    }

    // ---- host-mapped routing ring + response, pinned staging for the embedding / hop / token
    void* hp = nullptr;
    if (cudaHostAlloc(&hp, sizeof(gf::MoeRequest) * gf::kRingSize + sizeof(int), cudaHostAllocMapped) != cudaSuccess) {
        err = "glm fast: the routing ring did not allocate";
        return false;
    }
    std::memset(hp, 0, sizeof(gf::MoeRequest) * gf::kRingSize + sizeof(int));
    F->ring_h = (gf::MoeRequest*) hp;
    void* dp = nullptr;
    cudaHostGetDevicePointer(&dp, hp, 0);
    F->md.ring = dp;
    F->route_error_h = (volatile int*) (F->ring_h + gf::kRingSize);
